title: Beanjar secure-store inputs (identity/sestore.toml)
description: Per-VM secure-store values. See docs/user/sestore.md. Limits this schema cannot check: each decoded value is at most 65536 bytes, the TOML document at most 64 MiB, referenced files must be regular files with owner-only permissions, and PEM contents are validated by the host at launch.

missing.description: What to do for items the file does not configure. "fallback" (the default) adds a synthetic model key when no model item is configured and generates the SSG and DVR keys at launch; "error" adds nothing.

items.description: Secure-store items by exact name, as passed to SESTORE_ReadData, including regional suffixes. At most 256 items. Names are never hashed, renamed or uppercased.

entry.description: One item: exactly one of text, hex or file, optionally followed by a NUL byte.

text.description: The value as UTF-8 text. No newline, trimming or terminator is implicit.

hex.description: The value as hexadecimal digits, two per byte. ASCII whitespace (space, tab, newline) between bytes, or around the digits, is ignored; a byte is never split.

file.description: Path of a file whose exact bytes are the value. Relative paths resolve beside this TOML; absolute paths are accepted. The file needs owner-only permissions and at most 65536 bytes.

nul_terminated.description: Append one zero byte to the value, whatever its source.

model_key.description: Model secret: 44 canonical base64 characters for a 32-byte key, with no NUL or newline (so nul_terminated must be false). Canonical form and the choice of regional item are checked by the host.

ssg_key.description: Second-screen gateway private PEM key, nonempty, at most 1999 bytes, without NUL (so nul_terminated must be false). Launch generates the matching certificate. PEM validity is checked by the host.

youtube_key.description: YouTube credentials: printable ASCII <part1>;<part2>, both nonempty, followed by one NUL or LF, at most 100 bytes including that terminator. For authored text use nul_terminated = true; a text ending in LF is also accepted. The terminator itself is checked by the host.

dvr_key.description: The DVR's secure key: exactly 16 bytes (32 hex digits, or 30 with nul_terminated = true). Launch makes a random one when it is missing, unless missing = "error".
